summary: A board dissatisfied with successive computer rules considers whether to keep offering the service.
realLife: Greenville trustees considered ending internet access before choosing mandatory filtering after other measures had disappointed them.
inGame: needs: earlier trial policies and decision before the board.

turns.writesBack: The service continues under a revised rule.
